_comment: Real Google reviews, quoted verbatim, taken from the firm's Google profile via the Jotform widget on 7 October 2026. Only reviews naming Bev are included. Star ratings were verified individually rather than inferred from the 5.0 average. Do not add anything here that is not a real review, and do not edit the quotes: they are other people's words. Tags steer which review surfaces on which page - see reviews.html.

reviews.quote: Bev has been superb. She was patient with us, talked us through all our options and consistently kept us update with any changes. I cannot recommend her services enough.
reviews.name: Jonah Philpott

reviews.quote: Bev helped us through our application for a first time buyer mortgage and the support she gave was great. Easy to contact and made everything easy to understand. Would recommend to others!
reviews.name: Taylor Gilmour

reviews.quote: Very professional, courteous service, keeping us in the loop at all times and answering questions quickly so that obtaining our re-mortgage was as painless as possible. Thanks Bev and the team!
reviews.name: Clare Ford

reviews.quote: Excellent service by Bev. Very knowledgeable and professional and easy to deal with. Everything answered and assured us with confidence. Would highly recommend.
reviews.name: Eamonn Colbert
